title: Accounts near the minimum
hook: Two stated cases: explore the account count behind a percentage.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the account count behind a percentage affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Added, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the account count behind a percentage in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
